Termin is an app for booking appointments at hair salons. This policy explains which data we process, why, and what your rights are, in line with the Serbian Law on Personal Data Protection and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

• Phone number or Google account (name and email) — to sign in.
• Your name and, optionally, a profile photo.
• Appointments: salon, stylist, services, time, price and any note you write.
• Ratings and comments you leave after a visit.
• Favorite salons and stylists, waitlist and in-app notifications.
• An installation identifier for push notifications.
• Approximate location — only when you ask for “Nearby” or search; it is not stored on the server.
• Technical crash reports (without the content of your appointments).
To create and confirm bookings, send reminders and changes, prevent abuse (rate limiting and app integrity checks) and fix bugs. We do not sell data or use it for advertising.

The salon you book with sees your name, phone number, appointment and note, and your visit history at that salon. A stylist sees their own appointments. Ratings are shown publicly with your first name and last initial. Data is stored on Google Firebase infrastructure in the European Union.

When a stylist connects Google Calendar, Calendly or Cal.com, the server stores encrypted access tokens and uses them only to sync busy times and add appointments. The connection can be removed at any time.
As long as your account is active. When you delete your account (Profile → Delete account), we permanently delete personal data; past appointments remain with the salon only as anonymous statistics.

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability and objection, and to lodge a complaint with the Serbian Commissioner for Information of Public Importance and Personal Data Protection. For requests, write to the email address listed on the app’s Google Play page.
